Preserve his specific irregular natural East Asian facial structure exactly: narrow gently oblong face, natural slightly asymmetrical almond eyes, flat natural eyebrows, rounded natural nose, relaxed relatively full lips, slim jaw and very subtle chin stubble. He must remain visibly the identical specific man. Background: remove the dark/brown backdrop and any glow around the body completely; background must be real alpha transparency, including between hair strands and fingers, with no matte shadow, haze, dark halo, floor or vignette.
